Module cache 

Source
Expand description

How hot a session’s prompt cache is, for the cache badge both clients show (docs/site/specs/cache-aware-idle.md section 4.5). The daemon stamps each request’s TTL and plans the compaction before expiry; this only counts down.

Functions§

badge_text
The badge’s text: the countdown with ~ before an assumed TTL, compacting, ∞, or cache expired; empty while in use.
countdown
The countdown’s text: minutes, rounded up (41m); whole hours above 90 minutes, rounded to the nearest (11h); seconds in the last minute (45s).
detail_lines
The lines of the badge’s tooltip and of the usage panel’s cache card: its state; the request, its TTL and where it came from, and expiry; and the planned compaction, with the scheduled prompt that decided it.
heat
The heat of a cache with left of its ttl to go.
source_label
Where a TTL came from, for the tooltip and the usage card.
ttl_label
A TTL’s text: 1h, 30m, 90s, or never expires.
